The cost-benefit analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in program-level margins and aggregate totals.
The execution failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py during the call phase. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed when close(302.4, 4536.0) returned False, indicating a major calculation error in program-specific values. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with close(-61983.9, -79751.7), showing the aggregate 'total_annual_margin_10_day_usd' was incorrect. While the script successfully loaded and processed 3 of 5 tests, the core financial logic for margins and decision totals requires re-evaluation.
